ios.desc:
A daily check-in app for independent living.

Choose your check-in window. Tap to confirm you're okay. Miss your check-in, and your emergency contacts are notified automatically.

Built for people who value independence and their loved ones who want peace of mind                                                                                                       

HOW IT WORKS
1. Open the app and tap "I'm OK"
2. That's it. Do it once a day.
3. If you don't check in, your guardians are alerted

PERFECT FOR
• Anyone living alone
• Solo travelers and remote workers
• Families keeping an eye on aging parents
• People who value independence but want a safety net

FEATURES
• One-tap daily check-in
• Choose your check-in window: 2 days, 3 days, or 1 week
• Add multiple guardians 
• Push reminders to you before your window closes
• Sign in with Apple — no passwords to remember
• Privacy-first: we only store what's necessary

SUBSCRIPTION
DayTap costs $0.99/month after a free trial. Your subscription enables guardian alerts — the core safety feature that notifies your contacts if you miss a check-in. 

Privacy Policy: https://daytap.app/privacy.html                                                                                                                      
Terms of Service: https://daytap.app/terms.html
